title: 095. Coin Change
javaSig: public int coinChange(int[] coins, int amount)
prompt: Given `coins` denominations and `amount`, return the fewest coins needed to make `amount` (`-1` if impossible).
invariant: dp[a] = min(dp[a], 1 + dp[a - c]) with sentinel amount + 1
steps: For `a` from `1` to `amount` and each `c` in `coins`: if `a >= c`, set `dp[a] = min(dp[a], 1 + dp[a - c])`
pythonOutlineComments:
# Step 1: Allocate `dp = [amount + 1] * (amount + 1)` and set `dp[0] = 0`
# Step 2: For `a` from `1` to `amount` and each `c` in `coins`: if `a >= c`, set `dp[a] = min(dp[a], 1 + dp[a - c])`
# Step 3: Return `dp[amount]` if `<= amount` else `-1`

hints.title: Pattern & Invariant
hints.content: Core invariant: `dp[a] = min(dp[a], 1 + dp[a - c]) with sentinel amount + 1`

hints.title: Step-by-Step Plan
hints.content: Step 1: Allocate `dp = [amount + 1] * (amount + 1)` and set `dp[0] = 0` -> Step 2: For `a` from `1` to `amount` and each `c` in `coins`: if `a >= c`, set `dp[a] = min(dp[a], 1 + dp[a - c])` -> Step 3: Return `dp[amount]` if `<= amount` else `-1`

hints.title: Complexity & Edge Cases
hints.content: Aim for O(amount * len(coins)) time and O(amount) space. Watch empty inputs, single elements, and duplicates.
